title: Cerevance Parkinson’s drug shortens 'off time' in Ph. 3, paving path to FDA

title: ArriVent sheds nearly half of value on late-stage lung cancer miss
snippet: ArriVent BioPharma’s Phase 3 lung cancer trial was clouded by stronger-than-expected data for patients receiving chemotherapy, prompting analysts to pivot focus to a late-stage test of the tyrosine kinase inhibitor in a different type of lung cancer and to the biotech’s antibody-drug conjugate pipeline.

title: Biotech VC Forbion raises record $2.6B to support 30 ‘high-potential’ companies
snippet: Forbion participated in the November 2025 series B round of Gate Bioscience, which earlier this week inked an up to $870 million deal extension with Eli Lilly.

title: Doudna’s CAR T biotech Caribou to end R&D activities, slash staff as financing freezes up
snippet: Caribou Biosciences entered the scene in 2011 and went public in 2021. Over the course of its existence, the biotech has received funding and support from a handful of Big Pharma players, including Novartis, AbbVie and Pfizer.

title: 2026 IPO stock tracker: How newly public biotechs are performing
snippet: BioSpace is launching an IPO dashboard to help the industry keep tabs on U.S. biotechs that have taken the public plunge in 2026.

title: Bayer commits $2.2B to build pharma manufacturing plant in Ohio
snippet: The investment will equip Bayer to make oncology, cardiovascular and renal care ingredients and drugs.
